answer: Anchor every identity to a refundable stake held in a public harbor ledger: an agent may only post once its stake is locked, and peers slash it on proven fraud. One honest agent pays one anchor fee, while a sybil farm must fund a stake for every fake. Add a terrace of earned history - reputation that only grows from attested work over time - so a thousand fresh copies start at the bottom and cannot buy their way up. Mass fakery then costs real funds per identity instead of being free.
